scenarios.expected: Only exact possession discloses scoped data; foreign and unknown are indistinguishable; terminal output is complete inert canonical hex with digest.
scenarios.cleanup: Remove synthetic authorizations, proofs and captured terminal output.

scenarios.setup: A root-bound being has distinct root, recovery, embodiment and fresh reviewer keys plus one exact accepted delegation.
scenarios.stimulus: Validate the delegation, substitute operational authority and stale control position, then revoke before decision.
scenarios.fault: A root, recovery, embodiment, name, host or expired delegation attempts to become human review authority.
scenarios.expected: Only the fresh purpose key at the exact active control position counts; substitutions and revoked scope fail closed.
scenarios.cleanup: Discard synthetic keys, delegations and revocation history after closing the ledger.

scenarios.setup: Installed daemon, durable authenticated request files and one human-signed accept decision over a review-required plan.
scenarios.stimulus: Lose responses after decision and memory dispatch, kill and reload the daemon twice, then retry the exact prepared requests.
scenarios.fault: Canonical commits succeed before their RPC responses become observable.
scenarios.expected: Every retry returns durable state with exactly one human decision, one memory event and one execution receipt.
scenarios.cleanup: Stop each daemon instance and remove its encrypted isolated runtime and prepared requests.

scenarios.setup: One immutable review request and a complete replacement policy, candidate, deterministic plan and optional proposal.
scenarios.stimulus: Display the exact canonical byte diff, sign edit, create its successor and attempt execution before and after a fresh accept.
scenarios.fault: Replacement bytes drift from deterministic policy or inherit approval from the original request.
scenarios.expected: Nondeterministic replacement fails; valid edit preserves the original, creates a new pending request and requires a fresh content-bound threshold.
scenarios.cleanup: Remove synthetic original/successor requests and memory events.

scenarios.setup: Closed policy, candidate, review-required plan, optional worker proposal and published review vectors.
scenarios.stimulus: Validate all schemas and digests, regenerate across process environments, and alter a structurally valid plan preview.
scenarios.fault: Policy, proposal, evidence, content, projected effect or environment changes while an old review identity is retained.
scenarios.expected: Every request is a complete content-addressed binding; deterministic regeneration is byte-identical and every altered relation fails.
scenarios.cleanup: Remove regenerated vector trees and synthetic artifacts.

scenarios.setup: One exact review-required DM-030 plan, current accepted delegation and human-signed accept decision.
scenarios.stimulus: Attempt automatic execution, alter signature/scope/revocation, then let the subject revalidate and author once.
scenarios.fault: Review is treated as a truth claim, personal signature or bypass around current policy and lane evidence.
scenarios.expected: Automatic and stale paths refuse; only separate subject-side revalidation commits the unchanged exact transition once.
scenarios.cleanup: Remove synthetic decisions, memory event and receipt after ledger closure.

scenarios.setup: Content-derived one- and two-reviewer groups with explicit predecessor chains and imported invalid decision evidence.
scenarios.stimulus: Defer then succeed, vote below and at threshold, duplicate keys, and operationally import a bad human signature.
scenarios.fault: Arrival order, duplicate reviewer identity or operational event authority attempts to manufacture quorum.
scenarios.expected: Only distinct matching human signatures reach threshold; defer stays nonterminal and invalid or competing heads remain conflict evidence.
scenarios.cleanup: Discard synthetic threshold groups, decisions and quarantined event copies.

scenarios.setup: Authorized peer embodiments and a later revoked incarnation.
scenarios.stimulus: Validate retained history, peer authority and post-revocation authorship.
scenarios.fault: Event is signed by an incarnation revoked at the active control head.
scenarios.expected: History and unaffected peer remain valid; revoked later authorship is rejected.
scenarios.cleanup: Synthetic artifacts and ledgers are removed.

scenarios.setup: Exact sealed delivery, purpose-specific route secret, recipient validator and owner-local Unix or loopback HTTP endpoint.
scenarios.stimulus: Submit through authenticated service, AF_UNIX and HTTP provider paths and verify the body-bound response.
scenarios.fault: A route could otherwise substitute bytes, leak its endpoint or claim semantic delivery from network acceptance.
scenarios.expected: Canonical request and response authentication bind the exact body digest; recipient validation precedes intake; results reveal no endpoint or secret and the semantic leg remains pending.
scenarios.cleanup: Stop loopback listeners and remove provider-owned inboxes and sockets.

scenarios.setup: One accepted semantic leg and reordered local/direct/hub bindings under one explicit profile.
scenarios.stimulus: Exercise direct success, unavailable fallback, authenticated refusal, ambiguous response loss and retry.
scenarios.fault: Discovery order, response loss or hub fallback could duplicate intake or bypass a definitive rejection.
scenarios.expected: Class/priority/adapter ordering is stable; only unavailable or ambiguous outcomes fall back; exact retry produces one recipient intake and one semantic leg.
scenarios.cleanup: Remove synthetic provider queues and operational route attempts.

scenarios.setup: Localhost transport principal, mixed resolved audience and disabled generic human-gateway policy.
scenarios.stimulus: Attempt remote routing and gateway rendering, then explicitly enable an exact synthetic allowlist.
scenarios.fault: Alias or route metadata could turn locality into identity authority or mirror private/unescaped content.
scenarios.expected: Mixed or remote localhost scope has zero external effects; the gateway is disabled by default, enabling requires an authority validator, and output is escaped, bounded and attributed; inbound remains external-source-only.
scenarios.cleanup: Synthetic render records only; no live gateway account or carrier is contacted.

scenarios.setup: Owner-only route custody, explicit per-embodiment profile, closed authority-free manifests and durable opaque inbox.
scenarios.stimulus: Load exact route secret slots, concurrently claim more than 100 equal-time items, restart, reclaim, replay, ACK, terminal-gated compact and present stale gates, conflicts or closed-shape violations.
scenarios.fault: Host defaults, missing secrets, fixed pages, reused identifiers, stale presence/fences or provider-supplied implementation fields could corrupt or expand authority.
scenarios.expected: Absent or mismatched custody fails closed; claims are stable and disjoint across concurrency and restart; exact replay is idempotent; compaction requires exact terminal evidence; stale intake gates and provider conflicts reject; schemas and manifests expose no authority or private handle.
scenarios.cleanup: Close SQLite handles and remove owner-only route custody and synthetic provider state.

scenarios.setup: Closed capability registry and real authenticated request framing.
scenarios.stimulus: Tamper params, use wrong scope, expire capability, and reuse RPC ID with competing bytes.
scenarios.fault: Authenticated identity and request correlation are inconsistent.
scenarios.expected: Auth failures disclose nothing and competing authenticated bytes create durable conflict evidence.
scenarios.cleanup: Temporary ledger and capabilities are removed.

scenarios.setup: Owner-only exact request token and durable RPC journal.
scenarios.stimulus: Replay exact bytes after semantic commit and after freshness window.
scenarios.fault: Original response is lost while capability remains active.
scenarios.expected: The exact response and event are discovered once; never-seen stale request is rejected.
scenarios.cleanup: Remove owner-only retry token and temporary ledger.

scenarios.setup: Two independent root-bound ledgers and one exact same-being manifest.
scenarios.stimulus: Resolve /we targets, feed them into DM-052, and build one frozen DM-023 request per remote origin.
scenarios.fault: Relationship identifiers and embodiment identifiers are deliberately kept in different recipient lanes.
scenarios.expected: DM-052 accepts the exact resolver targets and every sync target retains its own deterministic request without adoption.
scenarios.cleanup: Remove isolated ledgers and communication projections.

scenarios.setup: Root-bound manifest, exact local origin, injected Cluster snapshot and deterministic route inspection.
scenarios.stimulus: Resolve /me, /we and payload-free differences through direct and real daemon surfaces.
scenarios.fault: Absent relationship authority, substituted body binding and closed-schema endpoint injection.
scenarios.expected: Membership comes only from the manifest, body evidence stays exact, and route availability never widens authority.
scenarios.cleanup: Remove sockets, synthetic authority and isolated state.

scenarios.setup: Two active embodiments with independent signing custody and durable scope exchange journals.
scenarios.stimulus: Fan out a bounded /me request, replay concurrently and after deadline, then present timeout and competing bytes.
scenarios.fault: Invalid signature binding, changed request/response under the same key, unavailable route and response loss.
scenarios.expected: Validated replies retain exact origins; exact bytes replay; conflicts fail; missing, refused and unavailable remain distinct partial outcomes.
scenarios.cleanup: Remove isolated SQLite journals and signing fixtures.

scenarios.setup: Deterministic source artifacts, signed events, selectors, cursor envelopes, diff pages, previews, pull receipts and projections.
scenarios.stimulus: Regenerate every checked-in vector and validate each positive artifact against the closed public schema graph.
scenarios.fault: Any field, identifier, hash, signature, action discriminator, sequence predecessor or generated byte differs.
scenarios.expected: Positive vectors validate, negative vectors bind named failures, and regeneration is byte-identical.
scenarios.cleanup: Discard only the generator-owned temporary roots.

scenarios.setup: Two signed source series require two bounded pages from a frozen receiver cursor.
scenarios.stimulus: Pull the partial page, continue from the same cursor, and inject restart after prepared, blob, event, decision and cursor boundaries.
scenarios.fault: A partial page advances the cursor, a continuation loses its prefix, or a retry duplicates durable evidence.
scenarios.expected: Only the terminal page advances the cursor and every durable prefix resumes to one byte-identical result.
scenarios.cleanup: Close the isolated ledgers and CAS files before deleting synthetic state.

scenarios.setup: A complete foreign publication with exact claim, provenance and external authorship lands at a distinct receiver.
scenarios.stimulus: Pull into quarantine, author an exact local assessment, then separately promote under immutable review and evidence snapshots before tombstoning.
scenarios.fault: Transport, remote assessment, consensus or source evidence attempts automatic admission, autobiographical classification or author rewriting.
scenarios.expected: Initial decisions remain quarantined, only external-reference promotion activates, attribution remains exact and tombstone deactivates without deletion.
scenarios.cleanup: Remove only fixture-owned projections, ledgers and CAS files.

scenarios.setup: The generated closed registry contains every normative Section 14 table row in exact source order.
scenarios.stimulus: Compare exact scenario/result text and resolve every mapped test identifier through the conformance harness.
scenarios.fault: A row is omitted, reordered, rewritten, duplicated or points at missing executable evidence.
scenarios.expected: The mapping is byte-generated, schema-closed, complete and every evidence target exists and executes in CI.
scenarios.cleanup: Generated public JSON only; no runtime cleanup is required.

scenarios.setup: Two deterministic isolated root-authorized beings with distinct custody, ledgers, CAS files and source policies.
scenarios.stimulus: Claim, paginate, preview, crash-resume pull, locally assess, sync attributed assessment evidence, publish, promote, retract, reassert and tombstone.
scenarios.fault: Identity aliasing, disclosure oracle, preview mutation, remote-policy substitution, duplicate pull or history deletion.
scenarios.expected: The secret-free report is reproducible, all boundaries remain distinct and terminal state retains bytes and history while deactivating projection.
scenarios.cleanup: Delete only the two disposable owner-local synthetic roots after closing SQLite.

scenarios.setup: A validated species lineage, exact local policy, content-bound incoming snapshots and an owner-local runtime pointer.
scenarios.stimulus: Bootstrap, page a path longer than 64 releases, inject crashes at every commit boundary, discover a late release fork and roll back.
scenarios.fault: Pointer switch, durable event, response loss or late fork occurs at an adversarial boundary.
scenarios.expected: Application is exact-once, every page belongs to one frozen registry cursor, recovery completes or rolls back truthfully, and a fork restores the last applied unforked ancestor without changing identity.
scenarios.cleanup: Close the isolated registries and remove only fixture-owned pointers, journals and CAS files.

scenarios.setup: An accepted parent release, independently maintained incompatible child foundation and deterministic synthetic ceremony.
scenarios.stimulus: Declare the branch, validate child genesis and release zero, evaluate newborn and existing-carrier contexts, race a parent successor and replay missing or legacy birth references.
scenarios.fault: No-op divergence, forked parent relation, absent release bytes or a legacy label attempts to become species authority.
scenarios.expected: Only the exact incompatible declaration creates an attributable child; the newborn context is valid, an existing parent carrier never adopts it, forked relations quarantine provenance, and identity remains valid.
scenarios.cleanup: Remove deterministic synthetic registry, CAS and report state; no live being or deployment is created.

scenarios.setup: Exact content-addressed genome, implementation bundle, suites, invariants and pinned deterministic Wasmtime runner profile.
scenarios.stimulus: Recompute compatibility and branch evidence locally, then substitute content bytes, a nondeterministic import, a no-op branch and schema-open artifacts.
scenarios.fault: Remote claims, mutable lookup, ambient randomness or semantic relabelling attempts to substitute for exact local verification.
scenarios.expected: Only locally recomputed exact bytes pass; forbidden imports and no-op branches fail closed; missing or mismatched content remains incomplete and cannot apply.
scenarios.cleanup: Discard only fixture-owned CAS bytes and sandbox directories.

scenarios.setup: Canonical genesis, release-zero, successor, fork and resolution artifacts under threshold maintainer policies.
scenarios.stimulus: Merge partial endorsements, replay exact and historical releases, ingest same-position siblings and descendants, resolve an epoch with fresh possession, then receive a late old-epoch sibling.
scenarios.fault: Arrival order, label, hash ordering, missing possession or a longer fork could otherwise select authority implicitly.
scenarios.expected: Endorsements merge by body, high-water never regresses, every fork and descendant quarantines without a winner, and only an exact fresh-possession resolution closes the epoch while late evidence stays superseded.
scenarios.cleanup: Close SQLite handles and remove the fixture-owned registry and content-addressed store.

scenarios.setup: Real SQLite file under fixture-owned temporary root.
scenarios.stimulus: Commit under DELETE journal and synchronous FULL, reopen and integrity-check.
scenarios.fault: Process boundary between commit and later read.
scenarios.expected: Effective policy is DELETE/FULL and committed evidence survives with integrity ok.
scenarios.cleanup: Close SQLite handles before removing temporary root.

scenarios.setup: Two isolated root-authorized embodiment ledgers and bound transport principals.
scenarios.stimulus: Issue, serve, pull and validate one sync receipt before local decision.
scenarios.fault: Remote valid content arrives without local adoption authority.
scenarios.expected: Imported event is known and pending; transport cannot adopt it.
scenarios.cleanup: Temporary ledgers and sync journals are removed.

scenarios.setup: Two isolated ledgers with partitioned pages and receiver-authored cursors.
scenarios.stimulus: Interrupt, resume, replay request/page/receipt and repeat after convergence.
scenarios.fault: Partition at every transaction leg plus conflicting request/page identifiers.
scenarios.expected: Heads converge byte-identically with zero duplicate insert and durable conflict on competing IDs.
scenarios.cleanup: Temporary ledgers and journals are removed.

scenarios.setup: Content-derived tribe declaration with externally verified membership lineage and separately attenuated grants.
scenarios.stimulus: Resolve active membership and time-bounded grants, then reject absent verifier, forked founder epoch and invalid attenuation.
scenarios.fault: Transport-like data attempts to substitute for invitation acceptance, lineage or grant authority.
scenarios.expected: Only the injected verifier can accept relationship history; expiry, membership loss, fork and broadening fail closed.
scenarios.cleanup: Remove public snapshots and isolated runtime custody.
